gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Verifies that {@link CharSet#getInstance(String...)} parses each of the basic set-definition syntaxes into the expected {@link CharRange} contents.
ADDED i2: A null definition produces an empty set (no ranges).
ADDED i3: An empty definition string also produces an empty set.
ADDED i4: "a" -> a single "is" range for the character 'a'.
ADDED i5: "^a" -> a single negated-character range.
ADDED i6: "a-e" -> a single character range from 'a' to 'e'.
ADDED i7: "^a-e" -> a single negated character range from 'a' to 'e'.
ADDED i8: Asserts that the set contains no ranges and renders as "[]".
ADDED i9: Asserts that the set contains exactly one range with the expected {@code toString()} renderings for both the set and its single range. @param set the CharSet un
